scientific_integrity: The proof cites the published Johnson strong-two-monophonic property and known line-graph clique-complex equivalence as essential prior inputs. Only the signed first-homology symmetry lattice and its complete rational character decomposition are claimed as new; prior findings receive explicit credit.
scientific_limitations: The new assertion concerns only the integral S_n-module H_1 of the monophonic-position complex of J(n,2), n>=4. The ordinary face/facet counts, known clique-complex topology and nonequivariant wedge are already implied by published work and are explicitly not proposed as original. Finite checks cover representative small n and all 24 permutations at n=4; proofs via relative simplicial homology, induction and Pieri apply to all n. The rational decomposition is not asserted to lift to a decomposition of integral Specht lattices. Independent review and comprehensive priority clearance have not occurred.
title: Signed-pairing symmetry of first homology in triangular-graph monophonic-position complexes
